title: ExamResultsPublished (schemaVersion 1)
description: An admin published the results of a mock exam. Published once per exam; later results of the same exam come as StudentResultAdded. Consumers: notification.

studentIds.description: Students who have a result in the exam.

mockExamName.description: Name of the mock exam, shown in notification texts. Optional, added later (schemaVersion unchanged).

examDate.description: Date the exam was taken. Optional.
